数学题目和解题步骤如下：

## 题目
**计算：** $3.6 \times 31.4 + 43.9 \times 6.4$

## 分析
观察题中数的特点，发现 $3.6$ 与 $6.4$ 可以凑成 $10$。但是只有当与它们相乘的另一个因数相同时，才可以运用乘法分配律简算，因此可以将 $43.9$ 拆成 $31.4$ 与 $12.5$ 的和。

## 解题步骤

$$
\begin{aligned}
&3.6 \times 31.4 + 43.9 \times 6.4 \\
=&\ 3.6 \times 31.4 + (31.4 + 12.5) \times 6.4 \\
=&\ 3.6 \times 31.4 + 31.4 \times 6.4 + 12.5 \times 6.4 \\
=&\ (3.6 + 6.4) \times 31.4 + 12.5 \times 8 \times 0.8 \\
=&\ 314 + 80 \\
=&\ 394
\end{aligned}
$$

## 关键技巧
1. **拆分法**：将 $43.9$ 拆分为 $31.4 + 12.5$，目的是构造出相同的因数 $31.4$
2. **乘法分配律逆用**：$(3.6 + 6.4) \times 31.4 = 10 \times 31.4 = 314$
3. **凑整巧算**：$12.5 \times 6.4 = 12.5 \times 8 \times 0.8 = 100 \times 0.8 = 80$（利用 $12.5 \times 8 = 100$ 的特殊组合）

**最终答案：** $\boxed{394}$
</problem>

from manim import *
import numpy as np


class PythagoreanTheoremProof(Scene):
    """
    勾股定理证明动画场景
    
    证明步骤：
    1. 介绍直角三角形及其边

    def construct(self):
        # 配置参数
        self.a = 1.5  # 短直角边
        self.b = 2.0  # 长直角边
        self.c = np.sqrt(self.a**2 + self.b**2)  # 斜边

        self.color_b = GREEN
        self.color_c = RED

        # 执行动画序列
        self.show_title()
        self.introduce_right_triangle()
        self.show_theorem_statement()
        self.build_proof_construction()
        self.calculate_areas()
        self.derive_theorem()
        self.show_conclusion()
    
    def show_title(self):
        """显示标题"""
        title = Text(
            "勾股定理证明",
            font="Noto Sans CJK SC",
            font_size=56,
            color=GOLD
        )
        subtitle = Text(
            "Pythagorean Theorem Proof",
            font_size=32,
            color=GRAY_B
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle)
        
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.3), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(title_group, shift=UP))
        self.wait(0.3)
    
    def introduce_right_triangle(self):
        """介绍直角三角形及其各边"""
        # 创建直角三角形
        triangle = self.create_right_triangle(
            self.a, self.b,
            fill_color=self.triangle_fill,
            fill_opacity=0.3
        ).move_to(LEFT * 2)
        
        # 创建直角标记
        right_angle_mark = self.create_right_angle_mark(triangle)
        
        # 边标签
        a_label = MathTex("a", color=self.color_a, font_size=40)
        b_label = MathTex("b", color=self.color_b, font_size=40)
        c_label = MathTex("c", color=self.color_c, font_size=40)
        
        # 定位边标签
        vertices = triangle.get_vertices()
        a_label.next_to(Line(vertices[0], vertices[1]), LEFT, buff=0.2)
        b_label.next_to(Line(vertices[1], vertices[2]), DOWN, buff=0.2)
        c_label.next_to(Line(vertices[2], vertices[0]), UR, buff=0.15)
        
        # 说明文字
        intro_text = Text(
            "设直角三角形的两条直角边为 a, b，斜边为 c",
            font="Noto Sans CJK SC",
            font_size=28
        ).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # 动画序列
        self.play(Write(intro_text), run_time=1)
        self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(right_angle_mark), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(
            Write(a_label),
            Write(b_label),
            Write(c_label),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # 存储以备后用
        self.intro_triangle = triangle
        self.intro_labels = VGroup(a_label, b_label, c_label)
        self.intro_text = intro_text
        self.right_angle_mark = right_angle_mark
        
        # 淡出介绍部分
        self.play(
            FadeOut(VGroup(triangle, a_label, b_label, c_label, right_angle_mark)),
            FadeOut(intro_text),
            run_time=0.8
        )
    
    def show_theorem_statement(self):
        """展示勾股定理公式"""
        theorem_text = Text(
            "勾股定理",
            font="Noto Sans CJK SC",
            font_size=42,
            color=GOLD
        ).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        
        theorem_formula = MathTex(
            r"a^2", "+", r"b^2", "=", r"c^2",

        theorem_formula[2].set_color(self.color_b)
        theorem_formula[4].set_color(self.color_c)

            font="Noto Sans CJK SC",
            font_size=28,

        self.play(Write(theorem_formula), run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(proof_intro, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(1.5)

        self.theorem_text = theorem_text

            theorem_text.animate.scale(0.7).to_corner(UL, buff=0.3),
            theorem_formula.animate.scale(0.7).to_corner(UL, buff=0.3).shift(DOWN * 0.6),
            run_time=1
        )
    
    def build_proof_construction(self):
        """构建证明所需的几何图形"""
        # 说明文字
        step1_text = Text(
            "构造边长为 (a+b) 的大正方形",
            font="Noto Sans CJK SC",
            font_size=28
        ).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5).shift(RIGHT * 1.5)
        
        self.play(Write(step1_text), run_time=0.8)
        
        # 大正方形的边长

    def create_four_triangles(self, outer_square):
        """创建四个全等的直角三角形"""
        center = outer_square.get_center()
        side = self.a + self.b
        half_side = side / 2
        
        # 四个角的位置
        corners = [
            center + np.array([-half_side, -half_side, 0]),  # 左下
            center + np.array([half_side, -half_side, 0]),   # 右下
            center + np.array([half_side, half_side, 0]),    # 右上
            center + np.array([-half_side, half_side, 0]),   # 左上
        ]
        
        triangles = VGroup()
        
        # 左下三角形
        tri1 = Polygon(
            corners[0],
            corners[0] + np.array([self.b, 0, 0]),
            corners[0] + np.array([0, self.a, 0]),
            fill_color=self.triangle_fill,
            fill_opacity=0.6,
            stroke_color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=2
        )
        
        # 右下三角形
        tri2 = Polygon(
            corners[1],
            corners[1] + np.array([0, self.b, 0]),
            corners[1] + np.array([-self.a, 0, 0]),
            fill_color=self.triangle_fill,
            fill_opacity=0.6,
            stroke_color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=2
        )
        
        # 右上三角形
        tri3 = Polygon(
            corners[2],
            corners[2] + np.array([-self.b, 0, 0]),
            corners[2] + np.array([0, -self.a, 0]),
            fill_color=self.triangle_fill,
            fill_opacity=0.6,
            stroke_color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=2
        )
        
        # 左上三角形
        tri4 = Polygon(
            corners[3],
            corners[3] + np.array([0, -self.b, 0]),
            corners[3] + np.array([self.a, 0, 0]),
            fill_color=self.triangle_fill,
            fill_opacity=0.6,
            stroke_color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=2
        )
        
        triangles.add(tri1, tri2, tri3, tri4)
        return triangles
    
    def create_inner_square(self, outer_square):
        """创建中间的正方形"""
        center = outer_square.get_center()
        side = self.a + self.b
        half_side = side / 2
        
        # 计算内正方形的四个顶点
        corners = [
            center + np.array([-half_side, -half_side, 0]),  # 左下
            center + np.array([half_side, -half_side, 0]),   # 右下
            center + np.array([half_side, half_side, 0]),    # 右上
            center + np.array([-half_side, half_side, 0]),   # 左上
        ]
        
        inner_vertices = [
            corners[0] + np.array([self.b, 0, 0]),
            corners[1] + np.array([0, self.b, 0]),
            corners[2] + np.array([-self.b, 0, 0]),
            corners[3] + np.array([0, -self.b, 0]),
        ]
        
        inner_square = Polygon(
            *inner_vertices,
            fill_color=self.inner_square_fill,
            fill_opacity=0.5,
            stroke_color=self.color_c,
            stroke_width=3
        )
        
        return inner_square
    
    def calculate_areas(self):
        """计算面积并展示两种方法"""
        # 清理之前的说明
        self.play(FadeOut(self.step_text), run_time=0.5)
        
        # 将图形移到左边
        geometry_group = VGroup(
            self.outer_square,
            self.triangles,
            self.inner_square,
            self.side_label,
            self.c_label_center
        )
        
        self.play(
            geometry_group.animate.scale(0.8).shift(LEFT * 2.5),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        # 方法1：直接计算大正方形面积
        method1_title = Text(
            "方法一：大正方形面积",
            font="Noto Sans CJK SC",
            font_size=26,
            color=YELLOW
        ).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.5).shift(UP * 2.5)
        
        method1_formula = MathTex(

        ).next_to(method1_title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(Write(method1_title), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(Write(method1_formula), run_time=0.8)

        """展示结论"""

    def create_right_triangle(self, a, b, fill_color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.3):
        """创建直角三角形"""
        vertices = [
            np.array([0, 0, 0]),           # 直角顶点
            np.array([0, a, 0]),           # 上方顶点
            np.array([b, 0, 0]),           # 右方顶点
        ]
        
        triangle = Polygon(
            *vertices,
            fill_color=fill_color,
            fill_opacity=fill_opacity,
            stroke_color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=2
        )
        
        return triangle
    
    def create_right_angle_mark(self, triangle, size=0.25):
        """创建直角标记"""
        vertices = triangle.get_vertices()
        # 假设直角在第一个顶点
        right_angle = RightAngle(
            Line(vertices[0], vertices[1]),
            Line(vertices[0], vertices[2]),
            length=size,
            color=WHITE
        )
        return right_angle
